caption: The drawing consists of several stylized and symmetrical objects centrally aligned on a tan, parchment-like background. At the top, there is a large cross with broad, ornate arms outlined in red and filled with a yellow-gold color, accented by light blue patterns and rays emanating from behind its base. Below the cross, there is a bow-like shape with two looping ribbons outlined in blue, filled primarily with gold and red accents, and centered with a circular blue and gold emblem. Flanking this bow are two wings, each gold in color with dark red tips. At the bottom, there is a large circular medallion decorated with concentric geometric patterns in yellow-gold, red, and blue colors, the innermost part forming a sunburst shape surrounded by petal-like motifs. The overall composition creates a vertically stacked arrangement with the cross at the top, bow and wings in the middle, and the medallion at the bottom.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
